# Say Halo 0.8.28
- Fixes the microphone getting stuck after screen sharing or switching audio devices. Say Halo no longer sits at "Warming up…" or "Mic stopped" until you quit and reopen it. - If the microphone stops responding, Say Halo replaces it with a fresh connection within a few seconds. Reconnect works again instead of doing nothing. - A microphone that looks on but sends no sound is now detected and rebuilt before your next dictation. - As a last resort, Say Halo quietly restarts itself in the menu bar, after any dictation in progress finishes.
Existing settings, saved word replacements, models, and permissions are preserved.

# Say Halo 0.8.27
- A compact menu puts recording controls and microphone selection in one row. Start or stop with the circular control and choose an input directly from the menu. - See your last transcript and when it was created. Hover to preview more, then click anywhere on the row to copy the full text. - Save word replacements directly in the menu with From → To and the plus button, or press Enter. The saved count and Manage link sit beside Quick replace. - Microphone-health checks can retry a stopped recording connection once and show Reconnect if capture remains unavailable. Quiet pauses are treated as normal. - Downloaded updates appear as a clear install-and-restart row. Settings and Quit keep their standard keyboard shortcuts. - Cleaner text, a bright copy icon, a solid menu background, compact microphone options, and a right-aligned device name improve readability.
Existing settings, saved word replacements, models, and permissions are preserved.

# Say Halo 0.8.25
- Choose **Add Word Replacement…** from the menu bar, enter **Heard** and **Replace with**, and save your preferred spelling for future dictation. - Assign an optional global shortcut in **Settings → Word Replacements** to open quick entry from any app. - Saving an existing match updates and enables its saved replacement.
Your existing settings, replacements, and iCloud sync choice are preserved.

# Say Halo 0.8.24
- Find word replacement sync in **Settings → iCloud Sync**, near the top of Settings. - Your existing sync choice and word replacements are preserved when updating.

# Say Halo 0.8.23
- Adds optional iCloud sync for word replacements, including learned corrections. Enable **Sync word replacements with iCloud** on each Mac using the same iCloud account. - Preserves offline edits and deletions, with status messages when iCloud is unavailable or storage is full. - Keeps microphone choices, shortcuts, transcription history, word removals, and output formatting on each Mac.

Say Halo 0.8.22 improves isolation of left and right modifier shortcuts.
- A shortcut assigned to Right or Left now requires a matching known modifier side. Events without side information no longer start or stop that side-specific shortcut. - Either continues to accept both sides. To keep Left Command paste and screenshot shortcuts separate from dictation, choose Right under Settings → Hot Key → Modifier side. - To keep the recording timer visible in full-screen apps, set macOS Automatically hide and show the menu bar to Never.
This update preserves existing shortcut settings. It does not change Either to Right automatically.

Say Halo 0.8.21 adds recovery controls to Setup's optional first dictation step.
- Stop or cancel recordings started with your shortcut directly from step 6, including when the menu-bar icon is hidden. - Cancel transcription from the same step if processing is stuck. - The dictation step opens when recording or transcription starts.
Your existing shortcut, settings, and speech models are preserved.

Correct menu-bar setup guidance on older macOS versions. Say Halo controls its icon in the app; Control Center on macOS 14/15 does not list third-party apps. Setup now explains crowded menu bars, MacBook camera notches, and hidden menu-manager items, with a link to Apple’s instructions.

Say Halo 0.8.19 (build 106)
- Final dictation and insertion testing is optional; finish Setup once required permissions, model, and input are ready. - Retain microphone test results for the tested input when reopening Setup. - Menu-bar controls now live in Permissions, with a link to macOS settings and guidance when the waveform is hidden.

Say Halo 0.8.18 (build 105)
- Show Menu Bar Icon controls in General settings and Setup, with automatic recovery during capture and processing. - Green Setup check when completion and live readiness agree; amber exclamation when setup needs attention. - Finish Setup checks current permissions, model and microphone readiness, with refreshed devices when returning to the app.
